summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing an Investor Day webcast scheduled for September 16, 2026. The event will feature President and CEO Haytham Hodaly and the executive team, with technical presentations from partner representatives. This is a routine investor relations communication, not a special situation. There are no transaction terms, strategic actions, or unusual corporate events disclosed. The filing is purely informational regarding an upcoming conference call and webcast, with no implications for mergers, acquisitions, restructuring, or other special-situations categories.
